title: Cabin — Replacement of the Overhead Stowage Compartment Shells by the Increased Volume Item
abstract: Cabin retrofit replacing the overhead stowage compartment shells by the deeper item that takes the standard bag on its side, with the tie-rod positions moved and every bay re-placarded.

sections.planning_reason: Three operators measured boarding time on this type against comparable narrow-body fleets and found between ninety seconds and three minutes of additional time per turn, almost all of it spent finding stowage in the aft half of the cabin. On a short-sector network that is a schedule problem rather than a comfort problem. The delivered bin latch is also the highest reported cabin defect item, with a failure to stay closed in flight at about one per eight hundred flight hours.
sections.description: The bulletin replaces the bin shells with the deeper item, moves the tie-rod positions, changes the latch to the two-stage type and re-placards every bay to the higher load limit.
sections.accomplishment_summary: Take the cabin out of service and remove the sidewall and ceiling panels along the bin run. Remove each bin shell and its tie rods. Install the partition sub-assembly D2520121808497 and the partition assembly D2520129009055 at the new tie-rod positions using floating nuts EN194394K6 and washers EN557515-96. Install the trim kit D2520122039443 at the deeper aperture. Move the curtain rail D2520125397271 25 mm inboard at each bay end. Transfer the bin light assembly at functional item 47DL to the new shell. Install the two-stage latch and check the lift-before-release action at every bay. Do a static proof load at the sampled bays required by the task. Apply the 79 kg placard to every bay converted and remove the 68 kg placard. Do the cabin securing check with the cabin crew procedure and record the embodiment.
sections.effectivity_note: Applicable to CIRRANE-13 aircraft from MSN C00205 to MSN C00612 with the delivered bin shell. Aircraft from MSN C00612 onward are already at the standard. One aircraft in a special cabin configuration is excluded. A mixed cabin is permitted only if the placard for each bay matches the bin fitted.
sections.material_note: Kit K2520-2006-01 is supplied per cabin and contains the shells, the trim, the tie rods, the latches, the fastener set and the placards. Lead time is twenty-eight weeks. Removed shells are not returned and may be disposed of locally.

type_data.compliance_time: At the operator's convenience, and preferably during a planned cabin refresh.
